title: A money-recovery suit (plaint, eCourts status, order, the notice before the suit) and a consumer complaint
note: Made-up documents. The pre-suit notice has no case number: it belongs to the suit only through the parties. The consumer notice writes the number as 'C.C. No.' instead of 'Consumer Complaint No.'. A past hearing date must not be put in the calendar as a coming hearing.
